/pulls?state=all&per_page=100.body:
The generic App canonical encoder currently shares a name with several incompatible Definition, Runtime, OpenAPI and Producer/Studio encoders. The extraction needs one explicit semantic owner and portable conformance evidence before native implementation can safely consume it.

This Phase 1 PR implements `kumwe/canonical-json` from App baseline `960ce8ec00cf724a7cae03e5ba09c4852c9ab54e`:
- Three public metadata types: `Profile`, `FindingCode` and immutable `Limits`.
- A normative generic profile and 79 language-neutral vectors covering exact bytes/digests, int64/binary64 boundaries, UTF-8, UTF-8-versus-UTF-16 key ordering, PHP array shape, bounded inputs and deterministic refusals.
- Explicit byte/depth/node/output admission rules. These are documented safety refinements; this PR changes no App production behavior.
- A frozen test-only App oracle and package-owned semantic, hostile-input, metadata and negative architecture tests. The oracle does not ship in the consumer archive.
- Complete API/capability/service/semantic/ownership manifests, member documentation, standalone example, archive consumer proof and release-on-record automation.
- A committed handoff with this exact PR URL: KUMWE-MIG-2026-007 / KUMWE-CS-2026-007 / NRM-2026-009.

**Testing ownership:** the package owns semantic/metadata/corpus behavior. App's current `CanonicalJsonTest.php` stays while its production PHP executor remains active. The later Computation-owned native cutover removes that executor and its implementation-only tests. App keeps composition, audit/idempotency outcomes, authorization, persistence, lifecycle, delivery and recovery tests. The handoff inventories 13 direct production consumers and two test consumers. No vendor unit suite is copied into App.

**Validation:** [final-head CI passed](https://github.com/kumwe/canonical-json/actions/runs/34115081022) at `d3661bd5d4179c83cfb947f17799b7fe8ac5505e`, including the online advisory audit and complete package check. Locally: 9 tests / 568 assertions, 79 corpus vectors, maximum PHPStan, PSR-12, complete docs/manifests, 12 release-parser cases and a real 28-file ZIP installed as a no-dev dependency all pass. App's actual strict PackageManifests loader accepts the package as v2-manifested. Independent technical review found no remaining high-impact concerns after the input-bound, architecture and corpus corrections.

**Release prerequisite:** a maintainer must protect main and enable GitHub immutable releases before the first publishing merge. Release automation refuses unprotected-main mutations and verifies `immutable=true` after publication. No repository settings, merge, tag or publication were performed by this PR.

No production PHP executor, native implementation, runtime provider, native concrete signature or App adoption is included. Native FQCN/ABI signatures need their separate joint ownership agreement; immutable release verification precedes semantic-only App adoption, and Computation alone owns the later runtime cutover.
